title: agrimonia eupatoria subvar. longifolia
intro: Agrimonia eupatoria subvar. longifolia, commonly known as agrimony, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, wounds, and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of agrimony include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in wound healing and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of agrimony include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
